name: A7
description: A0 with a 3-minute per-task cap and 21 tool calls. One variable: per-task budget, the third budget-curve point after A0 (6 min / 40) and A2 (4 min / 28). Why: A2 matched A0 on dev and held-out with 27% less time, and resolved tasks average about 2.5-3 min, so 3 min tests where the cap starts cutting into successes.
